scope: All uncommitted UI refinements, new src/ui-accessibility.css, deterministic creator fixture, and their subsequent adversarial fixes.

standards.result: No documented standards violations or material code-smell findings.
sources: Nearby implementation conventions; no AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md or CODING_STANDARDS.md found.
standards.independentReport: Shared overlay focus handling and consolidated search closing reduce duplication. Runtime control issues were tracked separately under the spec/behavior axis.

spec.requirement: Que revises los controles de cada uno de estos para asegurarnos de questos funcionen de forma correcta
spec.adversarialRequirement: we didnt introduce any bugs or race conditions or something

findings.before: Focus remained on Pause; Enter paused again instead of dodging.
findings.fix: Leaving pause returns focus to the arena canvas while focused toolbar actions retain native keyboard activation.

findings.trigger: Enter held while pause or results autofocus a new button
findings.before: Repeated native Enter could activate Continue or Rematch without a fresh press.
findings.fix: Prevent repeated native Enter/Space activation before paused/finished/orientation early returns.

findings.trigger: Remote intro → playing while pause/orientation stays open
findings.before: Raw phase dependency reset focused Exit to the first overlay action.
findings.fix: Focus lifecycle depends on the identity of the selected overlay.

findings.before: Tab trap excluded Help and Fullscreen, which were only shown while paused.
findings.fix: Provide both actions inside the pause card; hide duplicate toolbar helpers during pause.

findings.trigger: Hold accepted-creation UI frame for account A; logout, create/sign into B; focus B editor; release old frame
findings.before: Old frame focused B's fighter list and jumped scrollY from20 to382.
findings.fix: The callback checks both session epoch and account owner before focus/scroll.

findings.trigger: Open Help from the new pause action, then close it
findings.before: Removing the native dialog did not restore focus to its opener.
findings.fix: Explicitly close on effect cleanup and restore connected opener within the current foreground region.
findings.status: fixed; related existing issue exposed by the new regression check

findings.trigger: Online touch pause → Help → resize landscape to portrait → close Help
findings.before: Orientation's focus attempt was blocked by native Help; cleanup restored the covered Help opener. Enter reopened Help behind the orientation gate.
findings.fix: Only the selected Game overlay is aria-modal; inactive overlays are aria-hidden. Native-dialog cleanup restores focus inside the current foreground dialog if the old opener is outside it.

spec.missingOrPartial: No additional confirmed material requirements left unresolved within the inspected scope.
spec.scopeCreep: The shared Modal cleanup was necessary to keep newly reachable pause Help controls usable.

reproduction.game: In a separate lobby tab: await import('/scripts/ui-accessibility-browser-regressions.js'); await window.runUiAdversarialReview()
reproduction.orientation: Resize to390×844 and evaluate await window.runUiOrientationRegression()
reproduction.nested: Resize844×390; evaluate await window.beginUiNestedOrientationRegression(); resize390×844; evaluate await window.finishUiNestedOrientationRegression()
reproduction.creator: On /create evaluate scripts/account-browser-regressions.js, then scripts/creator-focus-race-browser-regression.js. Requires deterministic QA fixture; no paid generation.

limitations: Browser evidence is Chromium with emulated CSS viewports and synthesized touch capability, not physical hardware or Safari/Firefox.
Held-key checks assert prevention of the native repeat default in the real component. Chromium's native repeat-button behavior was separately confirmed; trusted press tests cover the resume path.
Game timing is controlled at its existing initial/remote props for deterministic component cases; account and creator races use real QA HTTP/forms and explicitly delayed callbacks.
No review can prove absence of all bugs. No unresolved confirmed material issue remains in the inspected changes.
